meaning.zh:
“依我来看” 或 “在我看来”。

这个短语源自文学中的表达方式，可以追溯到19世纪的英国文学。在书籍里，作者会写下他或她的观点或感受。而在口语中，"in my book" 表达了一个人对某件事的个人看法或意见，表示这是个人的主观看法，而不是一个普遍标准。
meaning.en: This phrase originates from literary expressions, dating back to 19th-century British literature. In books, authors would write down their own viewpoints or feelings. In spoken language, "in my book" expresses a person's personal perspective or opinion on a matter, indicating that it is a subjective view rather than a universal standard.

lines.en: In my book, honesty is always the best policy.
lines.zh: 依我来看，诚实永远是最好的策略。

lines.en: That’s unacceptable behavior, in my book.
lines.zh: 在我看来，那是不能接受的行为。

lines.en: In my book, he’s the most talented artist of our generation.
lines.zh: 在我看来，他是我们这一代最有才华的艺术家。
